newsitem.title: UK: Europe funds still strong buyers of local equities.
newsitem.headline: Europe funds still strong buyers of local equities.

text.p: Fund managers in Continental Europe are still strong buyers of equities in the region, a Merrill Lynch survey showed.
The survey said bulls outnumbered bears by 28 percent in the March survey, slightly down from February's 34 percent.
It said managers in the region were sellers of UK and U.S. equities, buyers of Japanese and Pacific Basin equities, sellers of bonds inside and outside Europe and were raising cash allocations.
The survey was conducted by Gallup between February 28 and March 5 and covered 60 institutions responsible for funds totalling $514 billion.
Among the respondents, 93 percent expected an improvement in the general economic situation in continental Europe, with only 32 percent expecting a rising inflation rate.
The survey said managers preferred German to French equities, were moving to financials from cyclicals, and preferred large cap stocks.
